newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shiseido mulling another cosmetics plant abroad.
newsitem.headline: Shiseido mulling another cosmetics plant abroad.

text.p: Major Japanese cosmetics maker Shiseido Co Ltd said on Monday that it was considering building a cosmetics plant overseas as part of its globalisation plan.

The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Monday that Shiseido would invest more than 10 billion yen to build a plant in the United States, but a company spokesman said Shiseido had not decided details of the project.

He said Shiseido announced a five-year plan earlier this year to promote internationalisation of the company by enhancing its business activities in Europe, Asia and North America, and to aim to increase the company's overseas sales to 25 percent of its total sales, or 200 billion yen, by 2000.
"In order to achieve that, we are thinking of building a new cosmetics plant abroad, but its size and the period of construction are undecided at this point," he said.
The spokesman said Shiseido currently runs six cosmetics plants in Japan and seven overseas.
